event.desc: He was appointed as an emir (ta'ammara) during the reign of al-Zahir Khushqadam.
event.note: During the reign of al-Zahir Khushqadam (r. 865-872 AH / 1461-1467 AD)

person.note: トゥーガーン・ミーク（またの名をシャーリブと呼ばれる）。アッ＝サファティーの長女と結婚した。アッ＝ザーヒル・フシュカダムの治世下でアミール（将軍）に任命され、［何年］に没した。
Ṭūghān Mīq, also called Shārib. He married the eldest daughter of al-Safati, was appointed as an emir during the reign of al-Zahir Khushqadam, and died in [incomplete date in the source text].
